result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B makes Studio stand out more: it is larger, has a bigger price, a badge, an accent border and the only filled button, and its feature lists are evenly spaced. However, B's side cards differ in height and vertical position, which looks a little unbalanced. A is tidy and consistent, but its Starter and Network feature lists are stretched with uneven gaps, and its large two-line heading competes somewhat with the Studio card. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A marks Studio with a badge, a coloured border, a filled button, a bigger card and a larger price, and the side cards still look like part of the same set. In B, the feature lists in the Starter and Network cards are stretched with uneven gaps, so they don't line up with Studio's list, and the heading is big, bold and wraps onto two lines, which makes it compete with the cards. B's Studio card is also less distinct, since its price is the same size as the other two.
